content.content: 1. Necessity: the dependent needs the version global for printing the version — without it, printing on --version is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Invocation is where the elaboration meets the version global; the gate keeps the use sound without testing printing itself.
